facts.claim: A north star carries three to five input metrics: complementary factors a team can influence directly through the product
facts.excerpt: Inputs are a set of three to five influential, complementary factors that most directly affect your North Star Metric.

facts.claim: A metric the team can move directly is probably the wrong north star
facts.source_title: What makes a good vs bad north star metric
facts.excerpt: If you can move your North Star directly, it's probably not a good North Star.

facts.claim: Annual and monthly recurring revenue, daily active users, downloads, page views and registered users are all named as poor north star choices
facts.source_title: What makes a good vs bad north star metric
facts.excerpt: Bad North Star choices: ARR, MRR, DAU, ad impressions, downloads, page views, registered users, time on page.

facts.claim: Published north stars measure delivered value: nights booked at Airbnb, time spent listening at Spotify, rides per week at Uber
facts.source_title: What makes a good vs bad north star metric
facts.excerpt: Airbnb uses nights booked, Spotify tracks time spent listening, Uber uses rides per week, Amazon purchases per month.

facts.claim: Top-quartile consumer apps hold 25% to 40% at day 30 and their curves flatten between day 60 and day 90
facts.excerpt: Top-quartile consumer apps see Day 30 retention of 25 to 40 percent and flatten by Day 60 to 90.

facts.claim: Median activation sits at 41.7%, with the top quartile at 71% and the bottom at 19% — a spread wide enough that the median judges almost nobody
facts.source_title: Onboarding metrics that predict revenue activation
facts.excerpt: The median activation rate is 41.7%, with top-quartile products at 71% and bottom quartile at 19%.

facts.claim: Median time to value has compressed from 8.1 days in 2022 to 4.2 days in 2026
facts.excerpt: Median SaaS time-to-value has compressed from 8.1 days in 2022 to 4.2 days in 2026.
